answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: (1) the visible windows belong to Cairn's own spawns - MEASURED 2026-11-12: of 4 python processes, children 29212 (ground_loop) and 16184 (bus serve) own a console; (2) the venv launcher is the cause - an UNMEASURED hypothesis that the proof's launcher experiment settles either way; (3) the base interpreter named in pyvenv.cfg can import Cairn's dependencies - unmeasured; the build must check it and fall back to pythonw/venv-with-flags if not; (4) Claude Code's own bash/hook children are not Cairn's spawns and are out of scope.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder would ask: (a) where does the helper live? -> cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/windowless_spawn.py with a charter intention+why.json beside it, written before BUILDME crosses; (b) what is its signature? -> detached_kwargs(os_name=None) -> dict of Popen keywords, and background_python() -> str, the interpreter to spawn; (c) how does it pick the interpreter? -> on nt, read home from pyvenv.cfg beside sys.executable and use home\python.exe if present, else pythonw.exe beside sys.executable, else sys.executable; (d) what do callers change? -> replace start_new_session=True with **detached_kwargs() and sys.executable/'python3' with background_python(); (e) how is the Windows behaviour proved on Linux? -> tooth 1 injects os_name; tooth 2 needs real NT and says UNMEASURED elsewhere. The ticket carries all of this in decisions.
